description.summary: named shortcuts triggered by compositor-configured keybinds

protocol.description:
Lets a client register a named shortcut whose actual key combination is configured compositor-side (see ironland-compositor's `[shortcuts]` config), and be told when it's pressed and released.
Unlike a generic global-shortcuts protocol, names are a flat namespace shared by every client (there is no per-client id/app_id pairing) - this is intended for a single trusted shell process, not arbitrary third-party clients.
Version 2 adds `bind`, which registers a shortcut against a raw modifiers+keysym trigger supplied by the client at request time instead of a compositor-configured name - meant for a single other trusted process, the `org.freedesktop.impl.portal.GlobalShortcuts` backend (see `ironland-portal-global-shortcuts`), which negotiates triggers with arbitrary applications itself and only needs the compositor to grab the resulting key combination.
`ironland_shortcut_v1` version 2 adds the `output` argument to `pressed`, so a client that shows something in response (e.g. a launcher) can place it on whichever output currently has the pointer.

interface.name: ironland_shortcuts_manager_v1
interface.description: This interface allows a client to obtain shortcut objects by name.

request.name: get_shortcut

description.summary: obtain a shortcut object by name

request.description:
Create an object that reports presses/releases of the named shortcut. `name` matches a key in the compositor's `[shortcuts]` config; a name with no matching config simply never fires.
Requesting the same name more than once (from this client or another) is allowed - every resulting object receives the events independently.

arg.name: name
arg.summary: the shortcut name to listen for

request.name: bind

description.summary: obtain a shortcut object bound to a raw trigger

request.description:
Create an object that reports presses/releases of the given modifiers+keysym combination, regardless of any `[shortcuts]` config. `modifiers` is a bitmask: 1=ctrl, 2=alt, 4=shift, 8=logo (super); `keysym` is an xkbcommon keysym value.
A trigger already claimed by a `[shortcuts]` config entry or a `get_shortcut` name keeps firing only that one - this request never overrides those. Binding the same trigger more than once (from this client or another) is allowed - every resulting object receives the events independently.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroying the manager doesn't destroy shortcut objects already created through it.

interface.name: ironland_shortcut_v1
interface.description: Reports presses and releases of the key combination the compositor has configured for this shortcut's name.

description.summary: the shortcut's key combination was pressed

arg.name: output
arg.summary: wl_output name (e.g. eDP-1) the pointer was over when this fired, if any

description.summary: the shortcut's key combination was released
